arguments.summary: A supply chain compromise was executed via a phishing email that delivered a malicious payload to host 10.0.5.20. The attacker used a multi-stage attack involving an encoded PowerShell command launched from Outlook, execution of an unsigned DLL via rundll32 from the Temp directory, and establishment of a C2 beacon to a known-bad IP (198.51.100.23) over HTTPS. Lateral movement was observed via SMB to internal servers, and multiple critical service accounts were compromised. Containment actions included revocation of four high-privilege service accounts and execution of an Ansible playbook to rotate local credentials across 200 production hosts.

    meta:
        description = "Detects use of -encodedcommand in PowerShell (common in fileless attacks)"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1059.001"
        date = "2026-05-05"
    strings:
        $encoded = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $hidden = "-w hidden" nocase
        $nop = "-nop" nocase
    condition:
        all of ($encoded, $hidden, $nop)
}
